How We Met

It started with a chance encounter at a mutual friend’s birthday party in 2019. Alex was the one laughing loudest in the corner; Jordan was the one who couldn’t stop glancing over. A conversation about terrible movies turned into two hours of talking, a traded phone number, and a first date neither of them expected would change everything.

What followed was the kind of slow-burn that sneaks up on you — coffee turning into dinner, dinner turning into long walks, long walks turning into the realization that you’ve found the person you want next to you for all of life’s adventures.

The Proposal

On a crisp October evening, Jordan asked Alex to go for “just a short walk” through their favorite park. The fairy lights were strung along the path (a detail Alex only realized later took three friends and an afternoon to arrange), and at the end of it, there was a question — and a yes — that neither of them will ever forget.

We couldn’t be more excited to start this next chapter together, and we’re so glad you’re going to be part of it.
